def observe(name, depth=True):
    obs = R.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
    obs.save(str(OUT / name))
    return obs

def move(name, poses):
    res = R.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video='mp4', note=name)
